label: For "Customer Account Health Scoring": Combine usage, support, billing and relationship signals into an interpretable health score that CSMs trust and act on. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Weights set by hand never validated.
